entries.desc: On a wrapper-root layout (metadataRoot != gitRoot) the docs-drift preflight gate scopes fs/git to gitCwd and reports pass for an existing CLAUDE.md path reference

evidence.note: Wrapper-root smoke drives runReviewCliGates over a metadataRoot!=gitRoot fixture; with repoRoot: gitCwd the docs-drift gate PASSes (existing-under-gitRoot CLAUDE.md path not reported missing). Output: docs-drift wrapper-root smoke passed.

entries.desc: On a plain repo (projectRoot == gitCwd) docs-drift behavior is byte-identical to before; existing docs-drift-path-drift-smoke still passes unchanged

evidence.note: Existing plain-repo/DI docs-drift smoke still passes unchanged after the one-arg fix (projectRoot==gitCwd no-op). Output: docs-drift path+asset smoke passed.

entries.desc: If repoRoot is reverted to deps.projectRoot the wrapper-root regression goes RED, proving the fix is load-bearing; no managedAssetDefs/english-gate storyDir change in the diff

evidence.note: RED proof captured: reverting repoRoot: gitCwd -> deps.projectRoot makes the wrapper-root smoke FAIL with AssertionError missing path: dev-notes/wrapper-doc.md (exit 1). git show bc5865be confirms the diff is only the repoRoot arg + comment; no managedAssetDefs or english-gate storyDir change.

entries.desc: New wrapper-root smoke builds a metadataRoot != gitRoot fixture, runs the docs-drift preflight path-drift check, and asserts an existing-under-gitRoot CLAUDE.md path is NOT reported missing; smoke exits 0 (green)

evidence.note: New wrapper-root smoke builds a real git repo in a subdir (gitRoot) with metadataRoot = non-git outer parent and a CLAUDE.md referencing a path existing only under gitRoot; asserts docs-drift preflight does NOT report it missing. Exit 0: docs-drift wrapper-root smoke passed.

entries.desc: The smoke is wired into the validate battery (root npm test) and actually runs under lattice validate --story=B-f882 (its name appears in the run output)

evidence.note: Wired into root npm test chain: ...test:docs-drift-smoke && npm run test:docs-drift-wrapper-root && npm run test:e2e. Root alias test:docs-drift-wrapper-root -> npm --prefix packages/main run test:docs-drift-wrapper-root. Confirmed present in root package.json test script.

entries.desc: The smoke is proven RED against pre-fix wiring (repoRoot=metadataRoot): with the fix reverted the smoke exits non-zero; uses DI/fixtures, no host-machine layout dependence

evidence.note: RED proven: with repoRoot reverted to deps.projectRoot the smoke exits non-zero (AssertionError: docs-drift gate must PASS on wrapper-root, got status=fail, missing path: dev-notes/wrapper-doc.md). DI/fixtures use os.tmpdir + git init subdir; no host-layout dependence. Secondary assertion contrasts repoRoot=gitRoot (pass) vs repoRoot=metadataRoot (fail) with real fs+git grep.

entries.desc: Strengthened guard runs green on the fixed tree and mechanically verifies the review-preflight git-invoking gates receive the resolved gitCwd (not deps.projectRoot)

evidence.note: Strengthened guard runs green and prints: ✓ review-preflight docs-drift gate wires repoRoot: gitCwd (not metadataRoot). Balanced-paren-extracts the runDocsDriftGate(...) call and asserts repoRoot value is gitCwd.

entries.desc: Guard documents what it does and does not cover (review-preflight-specific assertion vs general lexical rewrite); no false positives on legitimate non-git deps.projectRoot uses

evidence.note: Self-test: GOOD fixture (repoRoot: gitCwd) -> 0 violations; BAD fixture (repoRoot: deps.projectRoot) -> flagged. Tightly scoped to the single docs-drift gate call; legitimate deps.projectRoot uses (managedAssetDefs/mdReader/codex) are NOT flagged (no false positives). Coverage doc block documents what it covers and does not (review-preflight-specific, not general dataflow).

entries.desc: If a review-preflight git-gate were wired to deps.projectRoot instead of gitCwd the guard goes RED (proven by temporarily reverting and observing failure)

evidence.note: RED proven: reverting review-preflight repoRoot: gitCwd -> deps.projectRoot makes the guard exit non-zero (GUARD_EXIT=1) flagging: runDocsDriftGate(...) repoRoot is deps.projectRoot — must be the resolved gitCwd. Restored to gitCwd -> green.
